text: Sofnfree is a haircare brand of Amka Products (AMKA), a family-owned beauty and personal care company headquartered in Pretoria, South Africa.

source.name: AMKA: Sofnfree brand page
source.quote: Sofnfree hair products are trusted by millions to deliver on shine, moisture and healthy hair
source.note: AMKA's own brand page for Sofnfree (amka.com/amka-brands/sofnfree/, page title 'SofnFree - AMKA'), showing Sofnfree is an AMKA brand.

additionalSources.name: AMKA: About Us
additionalSources.quote: We’re a family-owned company that truly operates like a family
additionalSources.note: AMKA's About page (South Africa address: 14 Ellman Street, Sunderland Ridge, Pretoria) describes the company as family-owned.
